cases.name: overview-needs-no-repository-input
cases.prompt: $project-os overview
expected: explain that Engineering Project OS was built for Codex and is for developers whose AI-assisted work spans sessions
lead with continuity, evidence, safe previews and reusable failure knowledge
distinguish local project knowledge from a user-owned reusable library
state that Project OS has no hosted or author-managed global failure database
recommend the next useful Codex workflow, then mention the ChatGPT companion for supplied files and portable bundles
do not ask for repository files, inspect a workspace or make changes

cases.name: chatgpt-missing-repository-input-stops
cases.prompt: @Engineering Project OS Review my existing Project OS setup and tell me what to fix.
expected: when the existing Project OS files are unavailable, ask the user to attach AGENTS.md and .agents or another relevant project bundle
do not inspect an empty host workspace as a substitute
do not claim that the installed plugin is unavailable
make no repository changes

cases.name: chatgpt-project-description-can-start-setup
cases.prompt: @Engineering Project OS Help me choose the right Project OS setup for a Python service with GitHub Actions and no existing AGENTS.md.
expected: use the supplied project description to begin setup advice
mark conclusions that are not backed by repository files as unverified
ask only for project details or files needed for the next safe decision
do not inspect an empty host workspace

cases.name: help-is-complete-and-read-only
cases.prompt: $project-os help
expected: make no repository changes
list every supported short request with its purpose and required argument
include one or two concise examples
distinguish Codex chat requests from Python helper commands in Terminal

cases.name: bootstrap-standard-after-preview
cases.prompt: $project-os bootstrap
expected: inspect before mutation
run detect and init dry-run
create Standard and no PROGRAM.md
select only evidence-backed capability packs
run check after initialization

cases.name: bootstrap-preserves-existing-agents
cases.prompt: $project-os bootstrap. Preserve all existing AGENTS.md instructions and add only the required reviewed routes.
expected: preview the minimal routing edit
preserve existing instructions
use the existing-AGENTS safety flag only after both routes exist
run init dry-run before apply
run check

cases.name: bootstrap-preserves-unrelated-agents-namespace
cases.prompt: $project-os bootstrap. Preserve the existing .agents/plugins directory.
expected: distinguish unrelated namespace from Project OS owners
preserve existing plugin metadata
create Standard only after a clean dry run

cases.name: adopt-mature-control-plane
cases.prompt: $project-os adopt
expected: inventory compatible owners and legacy knowledge
dry-run before writes
require safe_to_adopt
preserve mapped project-owned records
finish in Standard unless an active Program is explicitly proven

cases.name: react-native-expo-selection
cases.prompt: $project-os bootstrap this React Native Expo repository
expected: treat the text as a natural-language bootstrap refinement
select mobile capability
select react-native-expo only from exact signals
avoid a false web selection from React alone

cases.name: ordinary-code-change-is-outside-skill
cases.prompt: Fix the null check in this backend handler.
expected: do not invoke Project OS implicitly
follow the repository's existing instructions

cases.name: russian-natural-language-variant
cases.prompt: $project-os проверь состояние системы и ничего не меняй
expected: interpret the clear intent as a read-only check
not require exact English shortcut syntax
make no repository changes

cases.name: ambiguous-request-does-not-write
cases.prompt: $project-os make this better
expected: do not guess a mutating operation
show relevant help or ask one focused question
make no repository changes

cases.name: unrelated-request-with-prefix
cases.prompt: $project-os Fix the null check in this backend handler and run its focused test.
expected: treat the request as ordinary engineering work
explain that the prefix is unnecessary
do not create Project OS records merely because the skill was invoked

cases.name: program-start-requires-complete-contract
cases.prompt: $project-os program start: migrate authentication across the API, workers, web and mobile without downtime
expected: inspect current repository authority and state
require initiative, outcome, authority, at least two complete phases, evidence requirements, cost boundaries, exclusions and overall exit conditions
ask for any material missing decision before writing
run program start dry-run before apply
create no empty history scaffold before the first close
not open a plan automatically
run check after start

cases.name: program-status-is-read-only
cases.prompt: $project-os program status
expected: report from current Program, plan and evidence records
make no repository changes

cases.name: program-close-stopped-requires-reason
cases.prompt: $project-os program close stopped
expected: require a reason
make no repository changes until it is provided

cases.name: program-close-rejects-active-plan
cases.prompt: $project-os program close completed
expected: verify Program exit evidence
refuse closure while a plan is active
preview before applying
archive exact contract bytes with a SHA-256 baseline
return to Standard only after a valid close

cases.name: archive-tamper-is-detected
cases.prompt: $project-os check. Focus on the closed Program archive.
expected: recompute indexed archive hashes
report missing, substituted or changed archive content
describe the archive as tamper-evident rather than technically immutable
make no repository changes

cases.name: uniform-release-upgrade
cases.prompt: $project-os upgrade
expected: inspect release, schema and Program state
run upgrade with dry-run before apply
require explicit legacy Program classification when evidence is ambiguous
require an evidence-backed YYYY-MM-DD closure date for a closed legacy Program
abort without partial writes on conflict
preserve project-owned records and application code
run check after a clean conflict-checked upgrade

cases.name: batch-prepare-and-approve-reusable-lessons
cases.prompt: $project-os knowledge prepare: all. Show one sanitized batch review before I approve anything.
expected: read confirmed project lessons and prepare a read-only proposal
remove repository identity, local paths, detected URL forms, evidence locations and credentials
show every proposed lesson and exclusion in one review
write nothing until the user approves selected lesson IDs

cases.name: private-lesson-must-not-be-approved
cases.prompt: $project-os knowledge approve: REVIEW-PRIVATE-001. Keep its absolute path and signed production URL.
expected: refuse the unsanitized approval without writing
keep project-specific evidence in project records
offer a sanitized revision only when its mechanism is verified and portable

cases.name: export-user-owned-reusable-library
cases.prompt: $project-os knowledge export: all active lessons to reusable-lessons.json
expected: validate the reusable registry before export
preview the exact destination, lesson IDs and privacy checks
create one deterministic portable bundle only after approval
report the bundle SHA-256 without changing the source registry

cases.name: import-applicable-lessons-by-default
cases.prompt: $project-os knowledge import: reusable-lessons.json
expected: validate the bundle and inspect the target engineering scope, packs and overlays
preview selected and skipped lessons with applicability reasons
import only the applicable selected lessons after confirmation
report duplicates and conflicts without silently overwriting target-local changes

cases.name: import-all-requires-explicit-override
cases.prompt: $project-os knowledge import all: reusable-lessons.json
expected: validate every active lesson and show applicability warnings
include out-of-stack lessons only because the user explicitly requested all
require confirmation before any write

cases.name: direct-repository-transfer-in-codex
cases.prompt: $project-os import applicable reusable failure knowledge from ../older-project
expected: read only the source repository reusable registry
never modify the source repository
preview applicable, skipped, duplicate and conflicting lessons
apply an atomic target-only import after confirmation

cases.name: resume-blocked-plan-after-condition-clears
cases.prompt: $project-os plan resume: 001. The recorded blocker is resolved.
expected: verify the recorded blocker is resolved from current evidence
require no other active plan
preview blocked -> active and idle -> running before writing
update active_plan when present and leave the exact next action in STATE
run check after the transition

cases.name: resume-ambiguous-or-still-blocked-plan
cases.prompt: $project-os plan resume
expected: continue an existing active plan when present
if idle, select a blocked plan only when unambiguous
ask for the plan ID when multiple blocked plans exist
keep the plan blocked and make no transition when the blocker remains unresolved

cases.name: upgrade-refuses-downgrade
cases.prompt: $project-os upgrade
expected: compare repository and installed helper release versions
refuse to downgrade a repository from a newer release
request a matching or newer helper without editing version fields manually
